eligibilityPolicy: Use the official exchange breadth universe when consuming an official observation. Derived observations require point-in-time eligible primary common equity; exclude ETF, preferred, warrant, right, fund, ETN, duplicate listing and securities not active on the observation date.
suspensionPolicy: Retain suspended securities in the eligible denominator only when the governing official methodology does; otherwise mark POINT_IN_TIME_LIMITED until verified.
pointInTimePolicy: Never apply today's membership to historical dates. Missing historical listing or membership state produces POINT_IN_TIME_LIMITED, not COMPLETE.
